title: Earlier Late Fees and the Home-Site Lease Repayment Down Payment
content:
Under the Home-Site Lease, the down-payment percentage of a repayment agreement is reduced, in percentage points, according to the late fees for earlier billing periods — any billing period other than the most recent one — posted on the lease in the trailing twelve calendar months.

**Desk rule.** The percentage is reduced by 1.5 points when no late fee for an earlier billing period was posted on the lease in the trailing twelve calendar months; by 0.5 points when exactly one was; and not at all otherwise. The reduction is subtracted from the down-payment percentage before the percentage is applied.

| Late fees for earlier billing periods in the trailing twelve calendar months | Reduction |
|---|---|
| none | 1.5 points |
| exactly one | 0.5 points |
| two or more | none |

**Points of judgement**

- A late fee for the most recent billing period is not a late fee for an earlier billing period and is left out of the count.
- A late fee posted before the trailing twelve calendar months is outside the count.

**Hypothetical records**

| Late fees in the window | Of which for the most recent period | Earlier-period late fees | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 0 | 1.5 points |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | 0.5 points |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | none |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | none |
